title: J. Mater. Chem. A Advance Article: From machine learning to chemical insight
blurb: Co-authored Journal of Materials Chemistry A paper with Jingjing Zhang, Lily Robertson, Ilya Shkrob, and Rajeev Assary. The work connects ML-guided chemical insight with charge-carrier stability in non-aqueous flow batteries.

title: Automation-Accelerated Electrolyte Design — ACS Applied Energy Materials
blurb: ML-guided HTE for paired BTZ/LiTFSI solubility — m-xylene/acetonitrile mixture dissolves ~3 M of both, surpassing the 2 M ceiling for neat acetonitrile. With Lily Robertson, Hieu Doan, Kee Sung Han.

title: Comparative SECM + computational study of graphite-electrolyte interface — JMCA
blurb: H-functionalization on graphitic electrodes increases electron-transfer kinetics in non-aqueous redox media. With Curtiss, Assary, Counihan, Rodríguez-López, J. Zhang.

title: Building rfb-formulation-agent — redox-flow-battery formulation support prototype
blurb: A pre-v0.1 AI prototype testing whether structured retrieval, reasoning, and validation workflows can help organize redox-flow-battery formulation knowledge.

title: Joined AAOS as Data Science Engineer
blurb: Working on high-level enterprise data/AI workflow tooling at AAOS; public details intentionally limited.

title: Nature Communications — high-throughput robotic platform + active learning for electrolyte discovery
blurb: Co-authored work demonstrating an integrated robotic platform with active learning for accelerated discovery of optimal electrolyte formulations. The convergence of automation, ML, and battery chemistry.

title: US 2024/0252991 A1 — Crown ether modified cation exchange membranes
blurb: Filed patent on selective ionic-species recovery membranes. Application of redox-flow membrane chemistry to lithium recovery.

title: Transitioned from ANL to industrial data science
blurb: After 14+ years at Argonne National Laboratory, started a new chapter in industrial data science, applied ML, and AI engineering.
